items.headline: $STRK Jumps 30% as Starknet Weighs Layer 1 Shift
items.summary: $STRK rallied 30%, outpacing $BTC and $ETH, as Starknet debates a shift to Layer 1. Daily DEX volume on the network climbed to about $33.7M.

items.headline: $GRAM Pops 9% as Telegram Money Wallet Goes Live
items.summary: Telegram rolled out its Money Wallet for $GRAM transfers and collectibles, sending the token up 9% as fresh utility lands in the ecosystem.

items.headline: $STG Merger With LayerZero Is Complete, KuCoin Says
items.summary: Stargate Finance finalized its merger with LayerZero, per KuCoin, consolidating one of DeFi's biggest cross-chain bridging plays under $STG.

items.headline: $SYRUP Buyback Completed by Maple Finance
items.summary: Maple Finance finished its $SYRUP buyback program, tightening token supply as the DeFi credit protocol keeps building momentum.

items.headline: Travala's $AVA Gets an AI Travel Booking Agent
items.summary: Travala debuted an AI-powered travel booking agent, adding a fresh real-world use case for the $AVA ecosystem.
